description: This Java class defines a custom exception WorkingDaysNotFoundException, used to indicate that working days configuration for an organization was not found. It extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides constructors for default message and wrapping underlying data access exceptions.
external_methods: super(String message, String defaultUserMessage, Throwable cause)
